html:
Question 14
?

The function U(t) models the number of users of a new mobile phone app, t hours after launching the app. What is the best interpretation of U′(4)=650?

a
4 hours after the launch, there are exactly 650 users.
b
4 hours after the launch, the number of users decreased at a rate of 650 users per hour
c
The number of users increased by 650 during the first 4 hours
d
4 hours after the launch, the number of users increased at a rate of 650 users per hour
e
The number of users increased at a constant rate of 162.5 users per hour
Submit
